origin.description: Remove every package database stored by available_packages_set.
origin.details: rm() drops every name in the cache environment and returns NULL. This function returns that value invisibly. The manual page has no example line for this function.
origin.example:
stored <- available_packages_set("https://cran.r-project.org", "source", c(Package = "digest"))
result <- available_packages_reset()
cat(paste0("after set stores digest, reset() returns ", if (is.null(result)) "NULL" else result, ".\n"))

translation.description: Remove every package database stored by available_packages_set.
translation.details: Every cached database is dropped. R's rm() returns NULL invisibly, so this returns None. The manual page has no example line for this function.
translation.example:
from remotes.available_packages import available_packages_reset, available_packages_set
available_packages_set("https://cran.r-project.org", "source", {"Package": "digest"})
result = available_packages_reset()
print("after set stores digest, reset() returns " + ("None" if result is None else str(result)) + ".")
